Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The family has gathered here to fight to protect Earth from threatening beings!

 

In the June Update, we celebrate the addition of the Fantastic Four Theme.

 

Mister Fantastic, a genius scientist known as the most intelligent person on Earth,

and Invisible Woman, who brings the team members together,

received Tier-4 Advancement and new Uniforms.

 

Additionally, Franklin Richards, who can turn his thoughts into reality,

and Valeria Richards, who has unpredictable genius and outstanding intelligence,

have joined MARVEL Future Fight as new heroes!

 

Lastly, the new collectible content Emblem Collection,

and the new narrative content Multiverse Saga have been added

as well as various improvements so that all Agents can enjoy the game more conveniently.

 

Please check below for more details!

 

▣ Two New Heroes

 

Check out the abilities of Franklin Richards <Modern>,

who can create virtual reality and turn it into reality,

and Valeria Richards <Modern>, a prodigy with both precision and genius.

* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Two New Uniforms

 

Two Uniforms have been added in celebration of the Fantastic Four-themed Update.

Check out the abilities of Mister Fantastic <The Fall of the Fantastic Four>

and Invisible Woman <The Fall of the Fantastic Four>.

 

* The new Uniform skill effects are based on Lv.10 stats.

* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <June Update Celebration Event>,

and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

  

 

 

▣ Mister Fantastic, Invisible Woman Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Mister Fantastic, who can stretch his body like rubber,

and Invisible Woman, who uses her invisibility ability to act as a strong shield for her allies.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Franklin and Valeria Richards Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the June Update, Franklin Richards and Valeria Richards

will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Content - Multiverse Saga

 

With this update, ‘Multiverse Saga’, a new content that

Agents can experience the journey of specific heroes, has been added.

 

The first theme revealed in the Multiverse Saga is [Day of the Dooms].

Join forces with relevant heroes to overcome the approaching crisis!

 

1. In this theme, you can proceed through the story

using the designated hero and Uniform in each Chapter.

 

 

- Boss: 

Available when progressing to the last chapter.

- Hidden Boss: 

Available by clearing certain stages and purchasing the Multiverse Saga: Day Of The Dooms Plus Pack.

- First Clear: 

Agents can check out the rewards they can get when clearing a stage for the first time,

as well as additional rewards that can be obtained

by purchasing the Multiverse Saga: Day Of The Dooms Plus Pack.

- Crystal Chest: 

The Crystal Chest of the existing content 'Heroic Quest' has been transferred to the Multiverse Saga.

When clearing a stage in Multiverse Saga every time, Crystals are stored in the safe.

Agents can open the chest and obtain the stored Crystals

by paying a certain amount when the Crystal safe is full.

 

 

* In Multiverse Saga, the next Chapter will be unlocked 

after clearing normal Episodes of each hero's Chapter.
* If a Chapter Wait Time exists, Agents can play the next Chapter after the period has passed.

 

2. Multiverse Saga features special scenes as well as battles including

various gimmicks to help Agents immerse themselves in the flow of the story.

 

 

- Use tags with your heroes to overcome various patterns that occur in battle!

 

* Agents’ account information is not reflected 

in the specifications of the hero played during the Multiverse Saga.

(Level, Tier, Skill, Equipment, Uru, ISO-8, Comic Card, X of Swords, Team-Up Collection, S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive, Agent Bonus, etc.)

 

3. Agents can obtain Emblems, a new collectible item,

and various growth material rewards when they clear the Boss Chapter.

 

 

▶ Difficulties that have already been cleared can be automatically cleared with Clear Tickets.

▶ Special rewards and access to Hidden Stories are provided

through the Plus Pack, an exclusive product for Multiverse Saga.

 

Benefits of [Multiverse Saga: Day Of The Dooms Plus Pack]

1. Unlocks Plus Reward Acquisition

(Additional rewards can be obtained when clearing each Episode for the first time)

2. Unlocks Hidden Story Pack (Hidden Episode available for each Chapter)

3. Acquire 6★ Franklin Richards

4. Acquire 1,000 Crystals

5. Removes Chapter Wait Time

* The Chapter Wait Time per Chapter is every 24 hours.
The Chapter Wait Time will be removed immediately upon purchasing the Pack.
The next Chapter will open immediately once Agents clear all normal Episodes within the previous Chapter.

 

 

* Multiverse Saga: Day Of The Dooms Plus Pack can be purchased only once per account.

* Refunds may not be available as the effect of the Pack takes effect immediately 

upon opening the product in the Inbox.

* Plus Rewards for previously cleared Episodes will be distributed immediately 

upon opening the product in the Inbox.

* The Hidden Story that opens after purchasing this Pack can be used continuously.

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

 

▣ New Content - Emblem Collection

 

Emblem Collection, a new content that allows Agents to collect and grow 

the Emblems of Marvel's attractive heroes, has been added.

 

It can be accessed through [Menu] → [Emblem Collection].

 

1. <Emblem> and <Emblem Data> that can upgrade the Emblem are divided into Normal - Mythic rarity.

- Emblems cannot be acquired multiple times.

When a registered Emblem is acquired, it is converted to Emblem Data of the same rarity.

 

2. Agents can apply abilities that strengthen specific heroes

only in designated content when registering an Emblem.

- Emblems with high rarity have story dialogue. Check them during battle!

 

 

 

3. Agents can enhance Emblems using Emblem Data,

Emblem Enhancement Kit, and Gold after registering the Emblem.

- Only Emblem Data of the same grade as the Emblem can be used in enhancing.

- When a certain level is reached, the Emblem is automatically advanced, 

and no additional materials are consumed for advancement. (Can be advanced to Max 6★)

* The Emblem Enhancement Kit is used as a material only in certain levels.

 

 

4. The Star level of the Emblem Collection increases 

based on the growth level and the number of Emblems you own for each Collection.
The Collection completing rewards are paid at each level.

- A Collection Reward Slot will be distributed when the Emblem Collection Stars reach a certain level. 

 

 

- Agents can obtain a specific item once a day from each slot at a set probability.
- Collection Reward Slots have levels, and the reward items and the amount differ per level and slot.

* The changed reward list will be reflected after

15:00 (UTC+0) / 8:00 (PDT) the next day if the reward slot level increases.

 

 

 

[Chance of the Collection Slot Reward Acquisition by Level]

 

5. Emblem Chest has been added to the Dimension Chest category in the Store.

 

 

▣ New Products

 

Products that appear for a certain period if certain conditions are met

have been added to support new and existing Agents.

 

1. Products related to heroes and Emblems in the Multiverse Saga have been added.

 

 

2. The products below will appear when making your first purchase.

 

3. Products related to World Boss have been added.

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Franklin Richards, Valeria Richards,

Mister Fantastic, and Invisible Woman have been added.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.

- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season

the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.

- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.

- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase

when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

         

​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, one as an Otherworld Battle reward,

and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[June Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Heroic Quest will end after the June Update, and the following actions will take place.

- Crystals will be refunded based on the progress of each Heroic Quest: Fox Hunt (White Fox),

Friendly Neighbor From Another Dimension (Arachknight), and Wave of Destruction (Wave)

if each Heroic Quest Pack is not completed as of the start of the June Update maintenance.

Please check your Inbox.

- The accumulated Crystal storage amount obtained as a Heroic Quest completion reward is not reset.

- The Heroic Quest exclusive heroes have been changed to Crystal Hero.

A Tier-2 hero and 1,500,000 Gold will be distributed when purchasing this product.

 

 

* This product can be purchased once.

* If you already own the above heroes of Tier-2 or higher, the product will not displayed in the Store.

 

2. The Change Auto Option function has been added to the 

[Change Card Options] - [Change Normal Option].

- The name of the [Combine] menu of Comic Cards has been changed to the [Change Normal Option].

 

 

- Agents can conveniently change the options automatically by selecting the desired option.

 

3. An Artifact conversion system has been added.

Artifacts of 4★ or higher can be converted as the Artifact of Change.

This can be used as material for changing Artifact options.

 

 

 

4. The Selector: Norn Stone item selection window has been improved

so that the recently selected type of Norn Stone is automatically selected.

 

 

5. The UI and convenience of the Store have been improved.

- The method of changing categories has changed as follows:

Before: Change the category by scrolling down the screen

After: Change the category by selecting each category

- The price of the product can be checked in the list.

- Images have been added to make it easier to find items in the Store search.

- Token Shop and Shadowland Shop have been separated from the Store.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. Enemies do not appear when proceeding a battle directly in the

'Fate of the Universe' stage in Epic Quest <The Galactic Imperative> has been fixed.

 

2. Jocasta's Game Tip was repeatedly displayed and 

the Tier-4 category among Jocasta's Tips disappeared have been fixed.

 

3. The VIP Point has been automatically reflected for Agents who have not received

1,100 VIP Points after purchasing a 9-Year Anniversary 7-Day Check-In Pack.

 

4. Skills with [Enables Attacking enemies who have activated the “Ignore Targeting" effect.] text

cannot attack enemies in the Ignore Targeting state in Otherworld Battle has been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
